issues.problem: 'alike' is not in dārair api dhanair api ('even by wife, even by wealth'); small addition.

patch.old: even by means of wife and wealth alike.
patch.new: even by means of wife and even by means of wealth.

issues.problem: dākṣiṇyam (courtesy, politeness) rendered उदारता (generosity), which overlaps with दानशीलता for tyāgaśīlatā and blurs two of the five items; English has 'courtesy' correctly.
tyāgaśīla is a bahuvrīhi ('whose disposition is giving'); -tā makes the abstract noun. 'tat-puruṣa' is not right.
jānīyāt is optative (an injunction: one should know/test); the English turns it into a statement of fact. Hindi 'जाने' keeps the mood correctly.
issues.fix: One should test servants when sending them on an errand, kinsmen when calamity comes, a friend in times of misfortune, and a wife when wealth is lost.

issues.problem: 'already' is not in naṣṭam eva hi (eva and hi are both rendered by 'indeed'); the Hindi correctly has no equivalent.
issues.fix: and the uncertain is indeed lost.

issues.where: विवाह समान कुल में ही होता है
issues.problem: 'ही' adds an emphasis (eva) that the verbless maxim vivāhaḥ sadṛśe kule does not have; English 'marriage is within a family of equal standing' has none.
issues.fix: विवाह समान कुल में होता है।

summary: 17 units checked against the Sanskrit. Splits, sandhi undoing, roots and case labels are sound throughout (incl. kuta āpadaḥ, rakṣecchrīmatām, paṇḍito'py, dviguṇa āhāro). The one text_flag (verse 15, missing space in śastrapāṇīnāṃnakhīnāṃ) is real and the suggestion correct. 1 error: verse 11 English loses the optative mood of jānīyāt. 6 minor: an added bracketed gloss (1), small additions 'alike' (6), 'already' (13), 'ही' (14), a Hindi word choice for dākṣiṇyam (10) and a compound-type label (10).
